title: Prayer Hands
look: He wears his bleached black W365ORLD hoodie, black snapback and dark sunglasses in every shot. He is always walking forward, singing, through the aftermath of war: drifting smoke, dust, rubble, burned-out cars, broken walls, shell casings in the dirt, distant fires on the horizon. No blood, no bodies, no gore. Handheld tracking shots that walk backwards in front of him, long lenses, golden dust in god rays, anamorphic flares, IMAX-scale drone wides. Recurring motif: his two hands pressed together in prayer, raised to the sky.
